headline: Curiosity, put into practice.
introduction: I teach technology, develop software and explore how ideas become useful digital products.
story: My learning has always extended beyond the curriculum. Self-directed study in Python, Java and C grew alongside an interest in design and the practical side of building software.
Teaching and building now sit alongside each other in my work. I share technical knowledge through training, mentoring and project guidance, while continuing to develop applications independently.
Product thinking connects these interests: understanding a problem, considering the people using the software, and bringing design and development together.
